name: Rajesh Power Services Ltd
title: Rajesh Power Services Ltd - 544291 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 52% to ₹1,628 Cr with order book ₹3,326 Cr, but receivables jumped to ₹350 Cr, payables stretched to ~58 days, and the ₹2,200 Cr L1/bid book is still unawarded.

triggers.label: Receivables ₹181 Cr → ₹350 Cr (H2)
triggers.quote: the receivables have gone from INR 181 crores to INR 350 crores

triggers.label: Debtors ~78 days, March bullet billing
triggers.quote: the debtors getting moved to around 78 days, as we discussed

triggers.label: Order-book target ₹4,500 Cr missed
triggers.quote: There is no shortfall. It's just the tender results are not out.

triggers.label: FY26 order inflow ₹2,743 Cr
triggers.quote: During FY’26, the company recorded order inflows of INR 2,743 crores

triggers.label: Revenue growth ~40% held
triggers.quote: No, we are sticking with our previously committed guidance. No revision.

guidance.quote: So, for the next FY’27, we are looking at a 40% growth.
Roughly, EBITDA between 11% to 12% and PAT between 8% to 9%.
There is no shortfall. It's just the tender results are not out.
We are targeting somewhere above INR 5,000 crores of order book for FY27, closing.
we are targeting at further order inflows of roughly around INR 4,000 to INR 5,000 crores at the end of the year.
